name: agentfirewall
description: Real-time AI Agent Security Firewall — model-agnostic protection for tool calls, MCP, and API actions

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentfirewall/core && npm run build -w @agentfirewall/sdk && npm run build -w @agentfirewall/api && npm run build -w @agentfirewall/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agentfirewall/core && npm run test -w @agentfirewall/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentfirewall/core && npm run typecheck -w @agentfirewall/api && npm run typecheck -w @agentfirewall/sdk
